The extension used the version number 2.1.313 and was distributed between 2:27 a.m. and 1:35 p.m. Pacific Time. Cursor is an AI-powered code editor built from Microsoft’s open-source Visual Studio Code (VS Code), with support for VS Code extensions. Anthropic’s Claude Code extension brings its AI coding assistant directly into compatible editors,…

items.title: Drupal warns of critical Commerce Core flaw exploited in attacks
items.summary: Drupal warned admins to patch a critical access bypass vulnerability in the Commerce Core module that attackers are exploiting in the wild. Tracked as CVE-2026-118539, this flaw stems from a missing authorization weakness that can be abused by unauthenticated attackers and affects Commerce Core versions 0.0.0 through 2.41 and 3.0.0 through 3.3.13. The Drupal security team asked admins on the 3.x branch to upgrade immediately to Commerce Core 3.3.13 (or Commerce Core 8.x-2.41 for earlier versions) and audit orders for inconsistencies, since threat actors are exploiting this vulnerability in att…

items.title: Hugging Face malware campaign returns to hijack GPUs for crypto mining
items.summary: A cryptomining and backdoor campaign that abuses Hugging Face model repositories came back within days of being taken down. Its most popular malicious model was downloaded more than 28,000 times. Separately, researchers flagged a fake Solana starter kit on GitHub, live since late 2025, that is positioned to trick AI coding agents into installing a remote access trojan.

items.title: Fake PDF and search tools hijacked searches for 13.4 million Chrome users
items.summary: Ads promoted browser extensions as tools to find manuals, convert PDFs, or make searches safer. But many of these extensions sent users’ search queries through servers controlled by their operators. Socket researcher John Tuckner identified 319 extensions with an estimated 13.4 million installs over a decade. The extensions hijacked users’ default search settings and routed their searches through servers controlled by the operators before sending them to Yahoo or Bing. This gave the operators access to users’ queries and let them earn referral payments. Socket says the extensions were promoted…

items.title: Tänään tv:ssä: Yksi elokuvahistorian tunnetuimmista kulttiklassikoista – Kriitikot eivät lämmenneet sille vuonna 1975
items.summary: Tänään nähdään televisiossa vuonna 1975 valmistunut kulttiklassikko The Rocky Horror Picture Show. Vastakihlautuneet Brad Majors (Barry Bostwick) ja Janet Weiss (Susan Sarandon) joutuvat rengasrikon vuoksi hakemaan apua syrjäisestä linnasta. Siellä juhlia isännöi korsettiin ja verkkosukkiin pukeutunut tohtori Frank-N-Furter (Tim Curry). Tutkija esittelee vieraille uusimman luomuksensa, lihaksikkaan Rockyn (Peter Hinwood). items.title: Tilastokeskus: Dieselin hinnassa uusi ennätys

Dieselin keskihinta kohosi 2,5 prosenttia syyskuusta. Hinnan vuosimuutos puolestaan oli lähes 55 prosenttia. 95-oktaanisen bensiinin keskihinta oli lokakuussa 2,28 euroa litralta, 98-oktaanisen bensiinin 2,38 euroa litralta. Kevyen polttoöljyn keskihinta oli 2,04 euroa.
